deployment: Push main; existing repository hosting deploys automatically.

storage.adapter: Existing Payload DatabaseKVAdapter / PostgreSQL payload_kv table
storage.access: Collection public CRUD denied. Owner endpoint requires authenticated active super-admin or baxhen-admin.
storage.deduplication: SHA256 of normalized email, platform, other platform and requested format
storage.manageLink: Stable HMAC signed request ID, using existing PAYLOAD_SECRET; signature purpose scoped to unsubscribe. Rotating that secret invalidates old links.
storage.removal: Sets active=false; owner notification selection must include active=true.
storage.rateLimit: Best effort 6 valid signup attempts per minute per server instance, not a shared distributed limit.

notifications.ownerWorkflow: Sign in to /admin as platform admin, open ownerRequests on the same host. Filter active=true and matching platform/format before any explicitly authorized email. Include the matching signed leave link in future notifications.
notifications.syntheticQA: caption-kit-release-check@example.invalid / Release QA — synthetic request; inactive after smoke test. Exclude reserved invalid addresses from demand counts.

localization.futureWork: Add approved locale JSON, translated media/captions and route/locale selection together; validate guide, workbook, prompts, templates, DM flow, sales page and Whop listing/delivery as one edition. Only English is currently enabled.

paidContent: Buyer PDFs and ZIP are product-gated on Whop. No paid files, private HARs or database exports are in public/.
